meta.title: 口说无凭，文字落地：周报是你的保命符
meta.title_en: Put It in Writing: The Weekly Report Is Your Safety Net

scenes.context: 老板说只要结果，讲者建议主动约定每周发进度表，风险类问题才当面汇报。
sentences: 有的上级说，我更关心这个事情的结果，不要什么事都来找我。
Some managers say: I only care about results — don't come to me with everything.
目标导向：results-driven
遇到你自己解决不了的问题，比如风险、资源，你肯定要跟他讲。
When you hit something you can't solve — a risk or missing resources — you have to tell him.
风险/资源：risks and resources
我每周把项目的进度写成项目管理表发给你。
I'll send you a weekly project status table.
项目管理表：project status table
paraphrase: 只要结果 ≠ 不用汇报
scenes.speak: Some managers say: I only care about results — don't come to me with everything. When you hit something you can't solve — a risk or missing resources — you have to tell him. I'll send you a weekly project status table.

scenes.context: 遇到搞不定的风险要简明汇报并拿老板表态，被反问就出示沟通记录与会议纪要。
sentences: 如果这个问题不解决，有可能会延迟个四五天，你那边觉得OK吗？
If we don't fix this, it may slip four or five days — are you okay with that?
延迟四五天：slip four or five days
我已经跟他们沟通了两次，会议纪要我已经发给你了。
I've talked to them twice, and I've already sent you the meeting notes.
会议纪要：meeting notes
他们那边老板说必须您出面才行，我的影响力太小，搞不定。
Their manager said only you can step in — my influence is too small to handle it.
影响力太小：not enough influence
paraphrase: Updates leave a paper trail for decisions.
把「他说过」变成「记录里写着」
Turn 'he said so' into 'it's on record.'
scenes.speak: If we don't fix this, it may slip four or five days — are you okay with that? I've talked to them twice, and I've already sent you the meeting notes. Their manager said only you can step in — my influence is too small to handle it.

scenes.context: 讲者用颜色预警机制和周报的合法性，讲如何让责任透明、保护自己。
sentences: 这个项目本来是绿色，然后变黄了，黄的意思就是这是个风险。
The project was green, then turned yellow — meaning it's now flagged as a risk.
黄色预警：flag as a risk
一周不管变红，再一周不管就超期爆雷。
Leave it a week and it turns red; another week and it blows past the deadline.
超期爆雷：blow the deadline
周报就是保护你们的，每周都要发预警给你老板。
Weekly reports protect you — send the alerts to your boss every week.
保护你：protect you
scenes.speak: The project was green, then turned yellow — meaning it's now flagged as a risk. Leave it a week and it turns red; another week and it blows past the deadline. Weekly reports protect you — send the alerts to your boss every week.

practice: I'll send you a weekly status update.
The meeting notes are already in your inbox.
I'm flagging this as a risk before it blows up.
Let's put it in writing so it's on record.
pitfalls: ✓ 地道说法：The project is now flagged as a risk.
变黄→被标记为风险，英文用 flagged。
✕ 直译腔：The meeting record has been sent to you.
✓ 地道说法：The meeting notes are already in your inbox.
✕ 直译腔：I want to protect my back.
✓ 地道说法：Cover yourself with a paper trail.
保护自己→cover yourself / paper trail。
✕ 直译腔：Don't do anything else when one thing is stuck.
✓ 地道说法：Don't put everything on hold over one blocker.
一件事卡住≠所有事停摆。
shifts: 把文字落地当唯一有效汇报
追问下一步，保住自己的业绩
footer_notes: ASR 校正：「目标倒向」校正为「目标导向」、「完全受权」校正为「完全授权」、「帅子」校正为「碎事」、「抵律」校正为「延迟」、「会议机要」校正为「会议纪要」、「打低机票」校正为「打低绩效」、「不知可否」校正为「不置可否」、「超全员」校正为「超期爆雷」；口播重复句已合并。
